description: This file defines a static class ConfigureWebServices with an extension method AddWebServices that registers various web-related services and configurations in the dependency injection container for an ASP.NET Core application.

classes.name: ConfigureWebServices
classes.description: A static class providing an extension method to configure web services in the application's dependency injection container.

methods.name: AddWebServices
methods.description: An extension method for IServiceCollection that registers MediatR, view model services, and configuration settings related to web services.
